name: Domain of Forgery: Severed Steel III
description:
Once a secret haven for rebels chasing the dream of a return to the old order. Their delusions died with the crimson fire, leaving only boundless ash.
Defeating the foes who lurk here may win you items that might be used to enhance your equipment.
disorder: Swirl DMG triggered by characters is increased by 200%, and Stellar Swirl DMG is increased by 60%.
